category_edits.rationale: Reduce tied item embedding and matching hidden width from 48 to 40 across all four datasets to test modest capacity regularization. Existing dimension-dependent layers, saved hidden_units metadata, and metadata-backed predictor construction propagate the new width consistently. Preserve causal blocks, features, readout, scoring, loss, optimizer, and one checkpoint per dataset.

change_summary: Reduce NextItNet tied embedding and hidden width to 40; existing checkpoint metadata and predictor writer maintain matching model shapes.
